div.head: Af 52
div.ab: Gif monnes tunge biþ of heafde oðres monnes dedum (ge)dón, ðæt biþ gelic eagan bot.
Gif monnes tunge bið of heafde oþres monnes dædum dón, þæt biþ gelic ⁊ eagan bot.
Si linguam extrahat, sicut de oculo componat.
Gif monnes tunge bið of heafde oþres monnes dædum dón, þæt biþ gelic ⁊ eagan bot.
If someone’s tongue is struck from the head by another man’s deed, the compensation is equal to that for an eye.
If, as the result of another's actions, a man's tongue is torn from his mouth, the compensation [to be paid] shall be the same as that for an eye.
Wenn jemandes Zunge durch eines anderen Missethat aus dem Kopfe gerissen ist: das und Augenbusse steht gleich.
If a person’s tongue is torn from the head through another’s misdeed: that is equal to the compensation for an eye.
